ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (16) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Tolstoy's two titles for the Didache are rendered literally: «Учение господа, преподанное народам через 12 апостолов» (Uchenie gospoda, prepodannoe narodam cherez 12 apostolov) as 'The Teaching of the Lord, Imparted to the Nations through the 12 Apostles,' and the short form as 'The Teaching of the Lord to the Nations through the 12 Apostles'; «нравственножизненная сторона» (nravstvennozhiznennaya storona) is 'the moral and practical side.' The source's dates and attributions (1883, 'Metropolitan Bryennios') are kept as printed; «отец, сын и святой дух» (otets, syn i svyatoy dukh) keep the source's lowercase.
